iv4r_infeasibility_flag_note: infeasibility flag = no_real_root (the null quadratic has no real root, hence no rational in-box root). For the d=(1..1) family at n=6 the ellipticity quadratic is degenerate (A = B = 0; conic, no x^5 condition), so the null family is the '1 = 0' sentinel, infeasible via no_real_root = True, not via a negative discriminant (disc = 0). disc_negative is recorded per tuple as a detail.

proof_first_b_index_0.proof: Null family: keep A, B from the d=1 n=6 ellipticity quadratic and replace C by C_null = sign(A)*((B^2+1)/(4|A|)+1). Then A C_null > 0 and B^2 - 4 A C_null < 0, so the quadratic has no real root and therefore no rational in-box root.
